definition: A reasoning framework that generalizes chain-of-thought by letting a model explore, evaluate, and backtrack across multiple possible reasoning paths structured as a tree.
details: Tree of Thoughts allows models to perform lookahead and self-evaluation across branching reasoning paths, improving performance on problems requiring search or planning, such as puzzles.
story: Picture a novelist who has read so much that, given a first line, they cannot help but write the next one. In plain words: A reasoning framework that generalizes chain-of-thought by letting a model explore, evaluate, and backtrack across multiple possible reasoning paths structured as a tree. Here is how it actually plays out: Tree of Thoughts allows models to perform lookahead and self-evaluation across branching reasoning paths, improving performance on problems requiring search or planning, such as puzzles. It is prediction pushed forward — each next word, or pixel, guessed from everything that came before it. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Tree of Thoughts.

citation.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
